title: Frequency, ECL110 displace and heat-curve offset hold the cycle's step through the next step
claim: The writes cut from the cycle's action (compressor frequency, ECL110 MQTT displace on both topics, the heat-curve offset entity) are never re-derived at a plan-step boundary, so with the default 30-min cycle over 15-min steps the command in force is another step's in 45-57 % of graded minutes on the reference plant.
mechanism: `_current_action` is cut once per solve (async_run_optimization -> get_current_action) and `_command_frequency` (via `_commanded_split`), `async_publish_current_action` -> `heat_curve.publish` and the valve hold schedule read it only inside `_async_update_data`; the supply (`pump_arbiter.supply_tick`, #2492) and the arbiter's one-minute tick re-derive their step each minute, these do not. A cycle whose tail lands after the boundary (cell 3478) writes the step it was cut for into the next one.

evidence.machine: box B11 (shared container, Linux 6.18, ~/venv-ci Python 3.14.7, hastub)
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats on the box; counts are contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact for a given phase set

perturbation.change: cycle every 15 min aligned to the step grid (optimization_interval 15, --interval 15 --phases 0): every write re-cut at each boundary

metric_definition: minutes >=1 min after a boundary whose in-force value != the step's own (displace_schedule[k] by plain index; frequency the value a same-step cut writes) / graded minutes
phenomenon_property: Every actuator write whose value is a function of the plan step is re-derived at each plan-step boundary (within the arbiter's one-minute tick), not only when the cycle runs.

null_control.note: a cycle on every boundary: all three shares 0, supply/mode/flow 0 in both arms

reproduction_steps: run timing.py: RESULT stale_share_mqtt_displace=0.5732, curve_offset=0.4644, frequency=0.4480 over cycle phases 1,6,11,16,21,26
cell 3478 line: frequency 65.5 Hz (partial's) in force in a full step whose own cut writes 90.0 Hz; mqtt '4' against the step's 6
proposed_fix_scope: coordinator write tail: re-cut the action's step-dependent fields (or the action) at each plan-step boundary from the same one-minute step tick that drives the supply, and run the frequency/MQTT/curve/valve writes from it, keeping their own rate limits.
